jobs.note: A coral ridge falls away into shoaling fish and open water.
jobs.caption: Coral reef / a world along the edge
jobs.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a NEW complete underwater landscape vignette for the FinFolk illustrated collection, landscape 4:3, fully opaque full-bleed raster artwork. The reference image is STYLE AND PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY: match its exceptionally detailed engraved 1960s/70s woodcut / three-ink screenprint drawing, sculptural natural forms, fine hatching, subtle ink texture and immersive underwater perspective. Create a genuinely different environment and composition. Every object must share one continuous believable environment with foreground, middle distance, receding landscape and naturally decreasing detail. The environment is the subject; no human figures or divers. Render a true underwater camera viewpoint inside the scene, never a flat design board or icon collection. Preserve excellent readable large shapes amid the detailed engraving. Colours exclusively acid yellow #edff35, electric cobalt #1641ff and hot pink #ff148d, plus their fine halftones/ink overlaps; vibrant saturated acid colour, no cream, beige, dusty rose, natural green or black. Scene: a magnificent living coral reef viewed from close to its outer edge, looking diagonally across a deep descending reef wall into luminous open ocean. A large sculptural table coral projects from the left foreground above branching staghorn coral, rounded brain corals, soft fans and small anemones rooted into the same continuous rugged reef. Schools of small reef fish curve around the headland in the middle distance; one naturally sized ray glides farther out in the open water. A visible refracted surface and subtle diagonal shafts of sunlight above. The reef ridge sweeps from lower left to distant right, forming a strong cinematic composition with depth. Intricate authentic coral anatomy in finely engraved cobalt-and-pink linework, bright acid-yellow water/light, pink corals and brilliant cobalt reef shadows. This is a whole landscape with a large open-water space, not a close-up pattern of corals. No shipwrecks, architecture, caves or ice.
